description: This Go source file defines a testing context for Kubernetes policy plugins, including a generic PolicyTestContext struct, methods for managing runtime objects, waiting for reconciliation, and dispatching admission operations. It also includes functions for creating new test contexts with fake clients, informers, and schemes, specifically for unit testing policy-related components within the Kubernetes API server.

classes.name: PolicyTestContext
classes.description: A generic testing context for Kubernetes policy plugins, supporting object management, reconciliation waiting, and dispatching operations.

methods.name: NewPolicyTestContext
methods.description: Creates a new PolicyTestContext with fake clients, informers, schemes, and initial objects for unit testing policy plugins.

methods.name: UpdateAndWait
methods.description: Updates or creates objects in the test context and waits for reconciliation if specified.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates or creates objects in the test context.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Internal method to perform object updates and optional waiting for reconciliation.

methods.name: WaitForReconcile
methods.description: Waits until the specified object has been reconciled by the policy source.

methods.name: waitForDelete
methods.description: Waits until the specified object has been deleted.

methods.description: Deletes a single object from the test context.

methods.description: Dispatches an admission operation for a new and old object.
